zh: 长度为 m+1 的窗口是否匹配，只取决于它内部 m 个相邻比较的结果，具体数值本身不重要。
先把数组转成长度 n−1 的相邻比较序列（每个位置是 1、0 或 −1），问题就变成在这个序列里统计模式 p 出现的次数，可以用 KMP。
对 p 求前缀函数；扫描比较序列时，失配就按前缀函数回退，匹配就前进一位；当匹配长度达到 m 时答案加一，并回退到前缀函数在 m−1 处的值，这样重叠的出现也会被统计。
en: Whether a window of length m+1 matches depends only on its m adjacent comparisons; the actual values do not matter.
Turn the array into its comparison sequence of length n−1 (each entry 1, 0 or −1). The task becomes counting the occurrences of the pattern p in that sequence, which KMP does in linear time.

Build the prefix function of p. While scanning the comparison sequence, fall back through the prefix function on a mismatch and advance on a match; whenever the match length reaches m, add one to the answer and fall back to the prefix function value at m−1, so overlapping occurrences are counted too.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Convert the adjacent comparisons into a sequence of −1, 0, 1, match the whole pattern with KMP, and after each successful match fall back via the prefix function so overlapping matches are kept.

## Why it works

Windows of length m+1 in the original array correspond one-to-one with windows of length m in the sequence of adjacent signs. The KMP state is the length of the longest match between a suffix of the scanned sequence and a prefix of the pattern; falling back on a mismatch keeps every prefix that could still match, and reaching m corresponds exactly to one valid window.

## Complexity

Time O(n+m), extra space O(m).
